name: Emergency Lighting Check
description: Corridors, stairwells, and vestibules must have emergency lighting

name: Panel Water Clearance Check
description: Electrical panel must maintain safe distance from water sources
message: Panel is only {value}m from water source, {threshold}m minimum required. Relocate panel.

name: Circuit Load Check
description: Single circuit load must not exceed rated capacity
message: Circuit overload (actual {value}A > limit {threshold}A). Split circuit or reduce load.

name: Outlet Spacing Check
description: Outlet spacing must not exceed code limit
message: Outlet spacing too large (actual {value}m > limit {threshold}m). Add receptacle.
